Fact: eval_results
What to find: Benchmark evaluation results (benchmark, metric, score).
Card sections that often contain it: Evaluation, Benchmarks, Results

Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: The card reports benchmark scores for the 8B Dense column (metric names not specified). Examples: AIME25 86.67, GPQA 64.14, LiveCodeBench v6 73.24, MMLU-Pro 74.04. Other 8B scores include SWE Bench Verified 47.67, τ³-bench (AVG) 58.06, and RULER 128K 71.41. Evaluations were run with a framework based on NeMo Evaluator SDK.
quotes: Evaluations are run with an evaluation framework based on NeMo [Evaluator SDK](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Evaluator).
